svg.text: Each P28 pin is its own open net. Nothing here connects to J1.
U_P28 is the upstream DIP-28 module (integrated RP2040). Not a Pi Pico. Not a new EPROM replica.
IDX pins are drawing indexes, not silk numbers and not a bus map.
44 contacts, 2.54 mm, 22 per face (STEP). Signal assignment is open.
NO EXTRA 7400 DRIVER IN THIS SCHEMATIC
Upstream P28 rev 1.10 already buffers ROM pins inside the module.
Address/control: U4 U5 U9 value 74LVC245, VCC +3V3_SYS, datasheet link SN74LVC245A.
Data: U10 MPN field C548858 = Nexperia 74LVC8T245BQ. A=+3V3_SYS, B=+5V_SYS.
Reset: U7 U11 74AHCT1G126 on +5V_SYS. Not a substitute for an unidentified 74xx part.
On-hand 7400 line drivers are a candidate only. Family and part number are pending.
RP2040 GPIO absolute max is IOVDD+0.5 V. Do not wire the robot bus straight to a Pico.
Stock P28 firmware uses GPIO23, GPIO24, GPIO25, and GPIO29. A Pi Pico does not break those out.
PCB coordinates in this file are placeholders. routingDisabled. No fab outputs.
Tooling checks are not electrical proof. Issues #46 #50 #49 stay open.
